offer.speaker: iruka
offer.text: Good morning, genin! Today you'll be split into three-person squads, each led by a jonin.

offer.speaker: naruto
offer.text: Team Seven! With Sakura-chan! ...And Sasuke. Ugh.

offer.speaker: iruka
offer.text: And you: Team Six, with Ren Sakuragi and Yui Hoshino, under jonin Tatsumi Kurogane. He's waiting for you at Training Ground 3.

steps.text: Meet your sensei at Training Ground 3

dialogue.speaker: tatsumi
dialogue.text: So you're the third one. I'm Tatsumi Kurogane, your sensei. That loud one is Ren, and that's Yui.

dialogue.speaker: yui
dialogue.text: Nice to meet you. Let's do our best.

dialogue.speaker: tatsumi
dialogue.text: Graduating the Academy only means you can learn. From tomorrow, I teach you what a real shinobi does.
